services.name: The Great Whistler Walking Tour
services.desc: About This 1.5 hour walking tour hits Whistler's must-see landmarks, significant works of art, and offers jaw-dropping scenery. As you see the sites and hear the stories, your local guide will give you an insiders view on all things Whistler. This tour also includes great recommendations and discounts! Duration 1.5 Hours Rates Adult (Ages 13+) - CA$59.99 Child (12 and under) -

services.name: Whistler Distillery Tour & Tasting Experience
services.desc: About Relax, leave the car at home and let us take you on a hassle free evening to Montis Distilling in Whistler, BC. This 2 hour tour will take you deep into the local neighborhood of Function Junction where you'll enjoy a guided tour of the facility, tastings of all available products and locally curated cheese + charcuterie. This tour also includes comfortable return transportation from your accommodation! Availability Fridays & Saturdays at 5.30pm (2 hours avg. duration) Or call 604 967 3509 to create your own itinerary! services.name: Full Whistler Sightseeing Tour
services.desc: About This fully guided Sightseeing Tour showcases everything the world class resort town of Whistler BC has to offer! An extremely scenic adventure to discover Whistler's most picturesque locations, Olympic venues, historic sites & hidden local artisan districts. This tour has something for everyone! Duration 3 Hours Average Rates Adult (Ages 13+) - CA$109.99 Child (12 and under) -
